owner.calling_convention_at_patch: RCX remains the destination/hash seed context, RDX remains the key source, RAX receives the global container, RBX receives its current root

generic_lookup.policy: the generic lookup is never patched

localization_state.live_observed_state: global container nonnull, current root null

native_fallback.relationship: the native miss constructs an empty result; the owner's existing null-result branch then reaches raw-key fallback

patch.healthy_path: replay both loads and movups xmm1,[rdx], preserve RCX/RDX, jump 0x3A6A4E3
patch.null_root_path: after the exact two loads, atomically increment the process-lifetime counter and jump 0x3A6A51A without writing the global container or current root
patch.global_container_null_policy: not guarded; the exact producer ordering proves it exists and the live failure is only active-root null

installation.transactional_rollback: target identity, protection, write, flush, and protection restore are verified; failed rollback retains the RX stub and ownership

semantic_scope.containment: only the Localize owner invocation with a published null current root enters its already-existing native miss path
semantic_scope.excluded: 0x3A70610 generic lookup and all producer code remain byte-identical
semantic_scope.heartbeat: startup_localize_current_root_guard_v1 publishes installed, failure, and native_miss_count
